sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Aniruddh Patel,Mahesh Chandra Maurya Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Heard the counsel for the applicants.
The present contempt application has been filed pleading willful disobedience of the order dated 9.12.2024 passed by this Court in Writ - C No. 40769 of 2024.

In pursuance to the previous order passed by this Court, the Standing Counsel has filed a compliance affidavit disclosing that an order dated 10.3.2025 has been passed by the District Magistrate, Azamgarh deciding the representation filed by the applicants and making a reference under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 regarding the claim of the applicants.
